statements.status_notes: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 fixes CVE-2023-54404 only in zod 4.6.6; 3.25.76 is the newest zod 3.x release and no 3.x fix exists. Teleport 18's web UI dependencies take zod 4.x at 4.6.6. The remaining zod 3.25.76 is required by @chakra-ui/cli 3.36.1, a dependency of @gravitational/design-system 0.2.0, and the latest @chakra-ui/cli release still requires zod ^3.25.76, so removing it means a zod major upgrade under that package. Whether this copy is reachable from the shipped web UI bundle is under review. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5

GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 fixes CVE-2023-54404 in zod 4.6.6. The remaining copy is zod 3.25.76, Studio's own catalog pin, also required by @hookform/resolvers 3.x, which reads ZodError.errors. zod 4 only provides .issues, so replacing that pin is a major upgrade. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.0 accepts zod ^3.25 || ^4.0, and its zod 4 copies are overridden to 4.6.6. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5
